page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre with Hebrew subtitle beneath. A calendar table in the centre: left columns of dates (civil month and day, letters and weekdays), a column of day numbers "Dies.", a centre column of festival and sabbath entries, and a narrow right-hand column of notes. Right-hand column of notes beside the table, then the catchword-like line "IVDAIC." at the foot right. Faint show-through text in the background is not transcribed.

main_text.p: Tertius in anno sacro. Charactere habet hoc anno 1. 7. 568.
A Paschate ad Pentecosten dies sunt 50. nobis Christianis dies 49.
23. desistunt ferre primogenita & primitias Ierosolyma in dieb● Ieroboam filij Nabat.
27. combustus est Rabbi Hanina una cum libro legis.

page.notes: The table is a calendar with Hebrew month name "סיון" (Siwan) in the subtitle. The table's day-number column is headed "Dies." (rotated). Faint background show-through from the facing page was omitted. Column layout is approximated as lines; the printed ruled columns are not reproduced exactly.
